title: Return Seasonality in Commodity Futures
about: Studies monthly seasonality across26 commodity futures from1970–2023.
findings: Authors report seasonal effects weakening in recent years, with same-month success mostly1990–99; combined momentum/reversal returns are not a validated native strategy.
mechanism: Seasonal demand or recurring investor flows could create persistence, but may be competed away.
